capabilities: Convert a Dataview query at the cursor into a Bases block
Convert all convertible Dataview queries in a note
Scan the vault and report which Dataview queries are convertible, partly convertible or not
Move inline fields into note properties
Undo the last move of inline fields
disambiguation: Not a runtime query engine or a Dataview replacement; it rewrites queries once and does not need Dataview installed.
extras: Needs Obsidian 1.10 or later (1.10 for the list view); the plugin only writes text, uses no network, and does not need Dataview installed. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A migration helper for people moving off Dataview, which has had no release in over a year
motivation: The author built it as a migration helper for people moving off Dataview, which has had no release in over a year, to the Bases core feature.
problem: Bases, Obsidian's core query feature, cannot read Dataview queries or inline fields, leaving users with queries that produce nothing after switching.

summary: Migration converter that turns Dataview queries into Bases blocks and reports which queries in a vault are convertible.
